# Test that we can unset variables, even if initially invalid,
# as long as resulting config is valid.

env BOLERO_ENV=badenv
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
env GOEXPERIMENT=

! bolero env
stderr '^bolero(\.exe)?: unknown GOEXPERIMENT badexp$'

bolero env -u GOEXPERIMENT

! bolero env
stderr '^bolero: unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair bados/badarch$'

! bolero env -u GOOS
stderr '^bolero: unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair \w+/badarch$'

! bolero env -u GOARCH
stderr '^bolero: unsupported GOOS/GOARCH pair bados/\w+$'

bolero env -u GOOS GOARCH

bolero env

-- badenv --
GOOS=bados
GOARCH=badarch
GOEXPERIMENT=badexp
